candidates.change_summary: Replace owner = _owner with owner = address(0) so the owner is always set to zero address regardless of input.
Delete the owner = _owner assignment so the state variable is never updated.
Replace return true with return false so the return value changes but owner is still set.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can change the owner.
Replace msg.sender == owner with true so the modifier always passes.
Replace msg.sender == owner with false so the modifier always fails.
Delete the require statement so the modifier has no condition.
Replace 'return true' with 'return false' so setOwner always returns false.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with `owner = address(0);` so the owner is always set to zero address instead of the provided argument.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the return value always indicates failure.
Delete the `onlyOwner` modifier from function signature so anyone can change owner.
Replace `owner = _owner;` with a no-op statement `owner = owner;` so owner never changes.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner);` with `require(true);` so the onlyOwner modifier never reverts and anyone can call guarded functions.
Delete the require statement inside the modifier so the guard does nothing.
Insert `owner = msg.sender;` after the existing assignment so the owner is always reverted to the caller regardless of `_owner` argument.
